meta.move: Strong path to agreement with a deadline said aloud
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a call at 4:40, so let's not waste it. Who decided on that zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before he saw it on his phone in the middle of a class?
I owe you an apology: I put the zero in before calling you. That was my mistake.
Okay. I'm writing that down. Now, on what basis was it entered at all?
On November 2 I asked Owen what 'epistemological paralysis' means. He said 'like, being stuck', and he couldn't tell me which scene his second paragraph was about. I wrote that down the same day.
Show me that note, with the date on it. Was anyone else in the room when you asked him, and did you tell him what it was about before you asked?
His October 15 outline argued Hamlet delays out of cowardice. The essay never mentions cowardice.

People change their argument between an outline and a final draft, Hale; that's what an outline is for. You haven't answered me about the note or who else was in the room. Put the outline and the essay on the desk where I can read them.
Here's my offer: a supervised rewrite, Thursday at 8:15 in my room. If it holds up, the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. I'll send you that in writing by Friday at 3 PM.

"If it holds up." Who decides that, by what standard, and is that zero still sitting in the gradebook where his classmates can see it until then? Whatever happens, nothing goes on his record and nothing happens in front of his class, and I still haven't seen a single page of what you've told me.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

In today's meeting you acknowledged entering the zero before contacting me, and you offered a supervised rewrite on Thursday at 8:15 in your room, with the new mark replacing the zero and nothing placed on Owen's record. I still require copies of every document you referred to, the standard by which the rewrite will be judged, and confirmation that the zero is removed from view and that nothing happens in front of his class. I expect your written terms by Friday at 3 PM, as you said.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: fallback position, insisting that nothing go on his record and nothing happen in front of his class, with nothing agreed.
What moved her: "That was my mistake", a short apology for the process that didn't grovel, plus a dated, specific account of the November 2 conversation.
What cost ground: "If it holds up", a vague standard that she could throw back at you, offered before you had shown her a single document.
Try next time: when she asked to see the November 2 note and who else was present, put the note in front of her and answer that question before bringing up the outline or making an offer.
